questions.question: Which event starts the delivery promise clock?
expected_facts: The clock starts at the accepted event, when the restaurant accepts the order

questions.question: What status does an order get when it has a cancelled event?
Which issue codes put the fault on the restaurant?
How many minutes past the promise can an Instant order be before it counts as late?
expected_facts: An Instant order is late when it is more than 5 minutes past its promise

questions.question: What base coupon does a late Instant order earn?
How many minutes past the promise does a Standard order need to be to count as late?
expected_facts: A Standard order is late when it is more than 20 minutes past its promise

questions.question: What base coupon does a late Standard order earn?
What coupon multiplier does a hop_pro customer get?
Does the tier multiplier apply when the fault is unknown?
expected_facts: No: with an unknown fault the customer gets the base coupon with no multiplier

questions.question: How much is refunded when an order is cancelled and the customer is not at fault?
How long does a refund take to reach the original payment method?
Can an order get both a refund and a coupon?
expected_facts: No, a refund or a coupon, never both

questions.question: Which promise times can a customer see at checkout?
How is minutes past promise calculated?
expected_facts: delivered time minus accepted time in minutes, minus promised_minutes

questions.question: What can the operations team do during heavy rain or a heat alert?
expected_facts: pause the 10 minute service in a zone

questions.question: How quickly does a report about a rider reach the rider operations team?
How are email and phone shown outside the support admin group?
expected_facts: four stars followed by the last 4 characters

questions.question: May support promise a refund before the facts are checked?
expected_facts: No, never promise a coupon or refund before the four facts are checked

questions.question: For order ORD-50003, was the order late under the right SOP, and what compensation does the customer get? Use the order's structured facts and the SOP binder.
questions.note: Multi-hop sentinel: needs the order's delivery class, times, tier and ticket issue code from the tables, joined with the matching compensation SOP and the tier SOP. Excluded from the hit-rate@5 / MRR denominator.
